meta_description: Izitayela zakho zokubhala, kuzo zonke izinhlelo zakho. Bhala kabusha, humusha, phendula.
h1: Bhala ngaphansi *kwesitayela sakho*, kuzo zonke izinhlelo zakho.
accroche: Umyalezo awunalo ithoni efanayo ku-imeyili yomsebenzi, isikhangiso esincane noma umyalezo wothandekayo. I-Plume yindawo yezitayela zakho zokubhala: ukhetha esakho, futhi sisebenza kuhlelo okukulo. Ugcina ikhibhodi yakho, uhlelo lwakho, futhi nguwe othumelayo.
demo_complice: Yebo impela, ngikhona kusasa! Ngitshele isikhathi esikulungele.
geste_intro: I-Plume ibeka ikhapsuli encane entanta phezu kwezinhlelo ozikhethayo. Kwenye indawo, ayibonakali.
tap_texte: Umbhalo wakho ubhalwa kabusha ngesitayela esikhethiwe, noma uhunyushwe.
micro_texte: Uyakhuluma, umbhalo wakho ubhalwa endaweni yokubhala.
styles_intro: Lapha, isitayela sokubhala sibizwa ngokuthi i-persona. Ezinye zinikezwa mahhala, ezinye zikulindele ekhathalogi.
styles_tienne_texte: Ngokubhalisa, wenza ama-persona akho: i-Plume ibe isibhala njengawe, hhayi njengabo bonke.
regles_texte: Nikeza i-persona noma imodi kuhlelo ngalunye: imilayezo yakho nge-Onobungane, inethiwekhi yomsebenzi nge-Ochwepheshile. Ithoni efanele isebenza ngokushesha uma uvula.
regles_note: Izinhlelo ongazilungisi zilandela isitayela sakho sokuqala.
lecture_texte: Humusha lokho okufundayo: i-manga, i-webtoon, uhlelo lwangaphandle. Ukuhumusha kuvela phezu kombhalo, endaweni yawo: ufunda ngolimi lwakho ungakopi lutho.
lecture_langues: I-Plume ikhuluma ulimi lwakho, futhi ihumusha ezinye eziningi.
lecture_consigne: Thinta « Humusha »: ukuhumusha kubekwa phezu kombhalo.
conf_titre: Lapho umbhalo wakho ucutshungulwa khona, *nguwe okhethayo*
local_texte: Imodi yasendaweni ihumusha efonini yakho: akukho okuthunyelwayo, isebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi — kodwa zonke izilimi azifakwanga ngokulinganayo lapho.
cloud_texte: Imodi ye-Cloud AI isebenzisa ithoni ye-persona yakho futhi isiza lezi zilimi; umbhalo wakho uthunyelwa kusevisi ye-AI ekhona ngaphandle kweYurophu, ngesikhathi sokucubungula. I-Plume ayigcini lutho.
ia_texte: Ukubhalisa kungeza i-AI esebenza kudivayisi: ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi, ngaphandle komkhawulo.
autorisations_texte: I-Plume isebenzisa isevisi yokufinyeleleka ye-Android ukufunda nokushintsha umbhalo endaweni obhala kuyo, uma uthinta ikhapsuli, futhi kuphela ezinhlelweni ozixhumile. Ukufunda okusizwayo kucela imvume yakho yokuthatha isikrini njalo uma uqala. Ayithumeli lutho ngasemuva, futhi ayithumeli umyalezo egameni lakho.
final_texte: I-Plume isetshenziswa mahhala, ngenani lokubhala kabusha ngosuku; isikhangiso esinomvuzo sivula okwengeziwe, asiphoqwa. Ukubhalisa kukhuphula imikhawulo, kuvula yonke ikhathalogi futhi kususa izikhangiso.
final_signature: I-Plume ayikufundisi ukubhala. Ikunika ithoni efanele, ngesikhathi ubhala.
autorisations_sans_lecture: I-Plume isebenzisa isevisi yokufinyeleleka ye-Android ukufunda nokushintsha umbhalo endaweni obhala kuyo, uma uthinta ikhapsuli, futhi kuphela ezinhlelweni ozixhumile. Ayithumeli lutho ngasemuva, futhi ayithumeli umyalezo egameni lakho.
